summary: The git module manages git checkouts to deploy software. If it hangs, the remote host is likely not in known_hosts; use accept_hostkey or pre-populate known_hosts with ssh-keyscan.
questions: How do I deploy code from a git repo with Ansible?
Why does my git task hang forever?
How do I add GitHub to known_hosts before cloning?

answer_card.title: Deploy from git; fixing hangs
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.git` manages git checkouts.

If the task hangs, SSH is probably prompting for an unknown host key. Fix by setting `accept_hostkey`/`accept_newhostkey`, or pre-add the key:
```
ssh-keyscan -H remote_host.com >> /etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts
```
